listing.name: Magician's Quest: Mysterious Times — MagiciansQuest-Recomp (waifoof)
listing.summary: This early alpha reaches character creation, the dormitory and the first school day with controls, sound and touch input. Broader campaign and multiplayer claims have not been confirmed by Portcove. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA YNNE Nintendo DS ROM, SHA-1 ab2e495f6206b5c9b69043f8b4114d760f7298b2. The European Enchanted Folk edition is unsupported.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the README for the rolling latest prerelease ZIP containing MagiciansQuest.exe and its compiler. Choose your own ROM and compile once locally. A developer source route also exists; its Windows bootstrap may install tools machine-wide, so review those changes before running it.

warnings: This early alpha reaches character creation, the dormitory and the first school day with controls, sound and touch input. Broader campaign and multiplayer claims have not been confirmed by Portcove.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
